description: This file defines the declaration of the cSettings class, which manages configuration settings stored in a JSON format. It provides methods to get, set, check, and remove key-value pairs, as well as read from and write to a configuration file.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: Class that handles reading, writing, and managing key-value settings stored in a JSON format, associated with a configuration file.

methods.name: cSettings(std::string file)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the settings object with a specified configuration file.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key from the configuration.

methods.name: setValue (string, string)
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair where the value is a string.

methods.name: setValue (string, int)
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair where the value is an integer.

methods.name: setValue (string, bool)
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair where the value is a boolean.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the configuration.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the configuration.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Persists current configuration data to the file.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Initializes configuration from the specified file.
